CalendarSubscription.what3: Meeting links are not written into the calendar. Every entry links to the session page, where the meeting link is.
CalendarSubscription.what4: If you leave a course, or lose access to it, its sessions drop out of your calendar.
Changes.note: Making a link creates a private address that calendar apps read your sessions from: the sessions of the courses you are enrolled in, have completed, teach or run, from 30 days back to 180 days ahead, with no meeting links. Anyone who has the address sees the course names and session times. The address is shown only when it is made. Renewing makes a new address and the old one stops working at once; calendars subscribed to it stop updating until you subscribe again. This cannot be undone.
